provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/switch.tsx — ONE element (`SwitchPrimitive.Root`, styled directly as the track — no separate track element), no owned label, no owned group, one cva-free literal className string, plus a `Thumb` child with its OWN literal className string. Token values from apps/v4/app/globals.css (light block from line 100, dark from line 144) — the SAME --primary/--input/--ring/--background/--foreground values every prior shadcn column in this pipeline has resolved from, re-derived here for a self-contained column. Read for the tri-state boundary check (there is none — see prop.checked-shape) and the group boundary: switch-demo.tsx, field-switch.tsx. Read only to fix structural boundaries (NOT canonical): apps/v4/registry/bases/{radix,base,aria}/ui/switch.tsx (radix's own base variant moves an equivalent Root+Thumb structure behind `cn-switch`/`cn-switch-thumb` class tokens, same conclusions, no extra capability — the SAME `size` prop and Root/Thumb shape appear there too) and apps/v4/content/docs/components/radix/switch.mdx, which LINKS to but does not itself document Radix's internal element. **primitives/ (Radix's own source) was NOT cloned** into 3-source/ for this build, matching the project's standing rule. Every cell depending on Radix's internal element/ARIA wiring (structure.native-input, behavior.role, behavior.keyboard-activation, prop.required) is marked [R] and cites the linked docs (https://www.radix-ui.com/docs/primitives/components/switch) rather than a grep.
provenance.no-primitives-clone: Same standing caveat as checkbox.shadcn.json: everything that is shadcn's OWN literal source — the className strings, the size prop, the absence of hover/pressed/validation classes — is [S]. Everything depending on Radix's INTERNAL element (is Root really a <button>? is there really a hidden bubble input?) is [R], cited to the linked docs.
provenance.track-rest: class `data-[state=unchecked]:bg-input dark:data-[state=unchecked]:bg-input/80` -> --input globals.css:118 (light, used at FULL strength, unlike checkbox's box which had NO background at rest in light mode at all) / :161 (dark, used at 80% via the `/80` alpha modifier, compiling to `color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 80%, transparent)` per Tailwind v4's alpha-modifier convention, the same derivation checkbox.shadcn.json's own box-bg slot used).
provenance.primary: class `data-[state=checked]:bg-primary` -> --primary globals.css:107 (light) / :150 (dark) — the SAME inversion badge.shadcn.json and checkbox.shadcn.json both recorded: light is near-black, dark is near-white.
provenance.thumb-bg / thumb-bg-checked: Thumb's own className: `bg-background ... dark:data-[state=checked]:bg-primary-foreground dark:data-[state=unchecked]:bg-foreground`. In LIGHT MODE there is NO `data-[state]` override at all — the thumb is `bg-background` (globals.css --background :101) REGARDLESS of checked, so thumb-bg and thumb-bg-checked are IDENTICAL in light mode. In DARK MODE the two diverge: unchecked -> `dark:bg-foreground` (--foreground :145), checked -> `dark:bg-primary-foreground` (--primary-foreground :151) — a real, sourced light/dark ASYMMETRY, the identical class of finding checkbox.shadcn.json's own box-bg slot already recorded for its component.
provenance.ring: class `focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50` -> --ring globals.css:119 (light) / :162 (dark) — applied to the Root/track itself, since there is no separate track element for the ring to sit on.
provenance.shadow-color: class `shadow-xs` = 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05). Tailwind is not vendored in this clone; reused verbatim from button.shadcn.json's already-extracted value, matching every prior shadcn column's own citation of the same fact. MODE-INVARIANT.
provenance.no-hover-no-pressed-no-validation: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly against BOTH literal className strings (Root and Thumb): there is no `hover:`, no `active:`, and no `aria-invalid:`/`data-invalid` class of any kind anywhere — switch has NO validation axis at all in this clone, the exact inverse of checkbox's finding that all three systems shipped one.
provenance.size-prop: Root's own destructured prop: `size = "default"` typed `"sm" | "default"`, SOURCE-DEFAULT-FIRST. `data-[size=default]:h-[1.15rem] data-[size=default]:w-8` (18.4px x 32px) vs `data-[size=sm]:h-3.5 data-[size=sm]:w-6` (14px x 24px); Thumb reads the SAME `size` via `group-data-[size=default]/switch:size-4` (16px) vs `group-data-[size=sm]/switch:size-3` (12px). translateX distance is a single literal, `calc(100% - 2px)`, unchanged by size.
provenance.no-track-element: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — `SwitchPrimitive.Root` carries the track's OWN background/shape classes directly (`rounded-full`, `border-transparent`, `data-[state=checked]:bg-primary data-[state=unchecked]:bg-input`); only `SwitchPrimitive.Thumb` exists as a child. See structure.track.
provenance.no-group-construct: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no switch-group.tsx, no SwitchGroup export, anywhere in this clone.
